preconditions.description: The number of records in the input is between 1 and 100,000.

postconditions.description: The number of records in the output is no more than 1,000,000.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(record, str) for record in output_sequence)
postconditions.description: Each record in the output sequence is a string.
Each record in the output sequence starts with 'insert', 'getMin', or 'removeMin'.

postconditions.expression: all(' ' in record for record in output_sequence if record.startswith(('insert', 'getMin')))
postconditions.description: Each 'insert' and 'getMin' record contains a space followed by an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(int(record.split()[1]) <= 1000000000 for record in output_sequence if record.startswith(('insert', 'getMin')))
postconditions.description: The integer in 'insert' and 'getMin' records is not greater than 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: all(heap.is_empty() == False for record in output_sequence if record.startswith(('getMin', 'removeMin')))
postconditions.description: The heap is non-empty when 'getMin' or 'removeMin' operations are applied.

invariants.description: The heap maintains its binary heap property at all times.
